mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, conditions are clear at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 39 degrees under a New Moon.
The Mark Drive reconstruction project is in progress, covering water and sewer improvements between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, with new sidewalks and landscaping planned.
There is plenty to do with trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga starting tomorrow.
In our weekly report, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I on October 25 after he was discovered unresponsive at a local intersection.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to start serving.
